name: Find decision makers
description: Find decision makers: website leadership crawl, sequential web SERP→LinkedIn /in/, filtered LI company employees, optional global LI search. Site visits low-concurrency; search engines sequential; LinkedIn sequential.

env.name: LEAD_DRY_RUN
env.description: Navigate/log; may write seed people if scrape blocked

env.name: LEAD_PEOPLE_WEB_SEARCH
env.description: Bing/DDG search for LinkedIn /in/ profiles before LI session

env.name: LEAD_WEB_CONCURRENCY
env.description: Parallel company website visits only (max 2). Search engines always sequential.

env.name: LEAD_SKIP_WEB_SEARCH
env.description: Skip Bing/DDG SERP (use after CAPTCHA; rely on websites + LinkedIn)

env.name: LEAD_WEB_DELAY_MULT
env.description: Extra SERP delay multiplier (on top of LI_SAFE_DELAY_MULT)

env.name: LEAD_WEB_USE_SYSTEM_CHROME
env.description: Prefer installed Chrome for ephemeral web browsers

env.name: LEAD_PEOPLE_LINKEDIN_COMPANY
env.description: Filtered LinkedIn company employees (keywords + title gate)

env.name: LEAD_PEOPLE_LINKEDIN_SEARCH
env.description: Last resort: global LinkedIn people search
